description: bellbook-core-signed-v1 profile vectors: each receipt paired with its validation status and every profile result validation reports for it (declared profiles in declaration order, then bellbook-core-signed-v1 where not declared); the tier met in each honest shape, one rejecting case per clause S0-S3, a stale declaration, and an Invalid receipt. Records by pinned authors carry real Ed25519 signatures.

cases.name: conformant-signed
cases.description: The honest signed story: the rules require a signature on every evolution kind and pin every actor's key; every record is signed by its pinned author; the two evaluations the claim uses are attested. Baseline and signed tier declared and met.

cases.name: conformant-signed-baseline-undeclared
cases.description: The honest signed story declaring only bellbook-core-signed-v1: S0 evaluates the baseline as the fallback and it conforms.

cases.name: conformant-delivery-under-signed-tier
cases.description: The honest signed story is also a delivery claim: all three profiles declared; delivery-receipt-v1 D6 evaluates the declared baseline, and the claim's attested evaluations satisfy S3. The capability profile a claim is judged under may be either tier.

cases.name: conformant-signed-tainted-history
cases.description: An attested evaluation no selection used is retracted by its signing author: the receipt is Tainted, which the baseline admits (B1), and the signed Retraction counts under S2. Still conformant.

cases.name: conformant-unused-v1-evaluation
cases.description: A signed evaluation.v1 that no selection uses sits on the record: S3 judges only the evaluations selections use, so the tier is still met.

cases.name: baseline-not-met-fails-s0
cases.description: Signed, pinned, attested, but the rules carry no evidence thresholds: the baseline fails B3, so S0 fails. The signed tier stands on the baseline.

cases.name: signature-not-required-for-every-kind-fails-s1
cases.description: Every record is signed and every author pinned, but the rules do not require signatures on Retraction and Requirement: a later unsigned record of those kinds by an unpinned actor would be accepted, so S1 fails. The tier judges the rule shape, not this log's luck.

cases.name: unpinned-author-fails-s2
cases.description: The producer signs its Requirement, Candidate, and Selection, but author_keys does not pin its key: the signatures verify against whatever key they carry and bind nothing to the identity. S2 names the unpinned author and the kinds it wrote.

cases.name: claim-uses-unattested-evaluation-fails-s3
cases.description: The evaluations the claim uses are signed by a pinned evaluator but carry bellbook.evaluation.v2, whose base class is Reported: a signature never promotes a class, the schema does. S3 fails and names them.

cases.name: claim-uses-v1-evaluation-fails-s3
cases.description: The claim uses a signed evaluation.v1 beside an attested one: one of two used evaluations is not attested, so S3 fails.

cases.name: declared-stale-hash
cases.description: The honest signed story declaring bellbook-core-signed-v1 with a hash that is not the published table's: the tier is evaluated from this validator's own table and conforms, but the declaration does not match, so the profile is not met.

cases.name: invalid-receipt-fails-all
cases.description: The honest signed story with the Candidate's signature stripped after export: the record's id no longer matches its content, the receipt is Invalid, and both declared profiles fail every clause.
